verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video generation product, since such products could ship downloadable weights or on-prem deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Kling's hosted platform: cloud API endpoints in Singapore and Beijing, credit-based subscription plans, and third-party API resellers. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment or downloadable models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
